envelope.description: Wire startTurn's read-only dispatch and post-dispatch fingerprint invalidation

body.title: Wire startTurn's read-only dispatch and post-dispatch fingerprint invalidation
body.summary: Replace startTurn's mode:'read-only' placeholder throw (src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts:653-656) with: re-check the cache by stableDescriptorHash at dispatch time, dispatch via buildArgv's read-only branch (t2) when 'qualified', throw VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError with the recorded reason when 'unavailable'; after a qualified dispatch completes, compare its own export.json against the cached effectiveConfigFingerprint and invalidate the cache entry on a mismatch (the completed turn's own result is unaffected by the mismatch).
acceptanceChecks: A read-only request with a 'qualified' cached capability dispatches via buildArgv's read-only branch and returns the schema-validated result
A read-only request with an 'unavailable' cached capability throws VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError carrying the cached reason, without spawning a process

A qualified dispatch whose own export.json diverges from the cached effectiveConfigFingerprint invalidates the cache entry for the NEXT call, while the current call's own result is returned unaffected

tests.name: a qualified dispatch whose own export.json diverges from the cached fingerprint invalidating the entry while still returning its own result
startTurn's mode:'read-only' branch re-checking the cache by stableDescriptorHash at dispatch time
a scripted post-dispatch export.json mismatch invalidating the cache for the NEXT call while the current call's result is unaffected
the VibeReadOnlyUnavailableError path when probes exhaust the retry bound or export.json is unusable
